about_the_game:
A sandbox sports game where you build dog agility parkours, choose a dog, and race through custom or pre-made tracks. Create tournaments as collections of parkours, invite players to join, and compete for prizes, blending creativity with fast-paced racing fun.

For every successfully completed parkour you will get the trophies based on the parkour difficulty and your results. You can also win the trophies by hosting or attending the tournament. The trophies can be used for getting new dogs or buy biscuits for refiling dogs’ stamina.

As in the real life the dog is not able to run forever and it needs to rest. As their stamina drops, they will slow down and needs either to be fed or rest.

Dog are easily controlled and they listen all your commands - you can guide them by WASD keys or show them the way using mouse. Use right click or spacebar for jump.

 

The game you can

  • run through more than 30 prepared agility parkours from easy to very challenging based on real agility championships

  • create your own agility parkour in editor and run it right away or save it for later

  • collect all dog breeds and variants

  • create an account and to share and compare your results

  • create tournaments for other players to compete for prize

  • or join existing tournaments and win

 

To connect the community for sharing results, creating or joining tournaments you need to create an account using e-mail and password. The e-mail will not be used for any other reason and the account can be deleted anytime from the game.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 700 MB available space

short_description: Enter the world of dog agility! Build your courses full of obstacles and run them with your dog. Jumps, tunnels and slaloms - it's all up to your design and skills. Create tournaments and compete against other players. Creativity and training will decide the new agility champion!
